Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. MAYOR ELDWIN M. ALIBUTDAN Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay Dear Mayor Alibutdan: 74 s. 2mo 01 June 2010 This pertains to your letter seeking guidance from this Department on the actual controversy in your municipality, specifically on the operation of cockpits. Per your letter, on 08 May 2000, the Sangguniang Bayan of Ipil has approved an ordinance granting franchise to Ipil Recreation Center to establish, operate and maintain a cockpit within the territorial jurisdiction of Ipil for a period of ten (IO) years. On 13 February 2008, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Zamboanga Sibugay granted a franchise to establish, operate and maintain a cockpit in the Municipality of Ipil by force of a Sangguniang Panlalawigan Resolution/Ordinance No. 628-2002 in favor of Ipil Square Garden. Prompted by the foregoing, Ipil Recreation Center filed a case before the Regional Trial Court, Branch 24, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, Special Civil Case No. 1-71, impleading as respondents Ipil Square Garden, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan and the Governor of Zamboanga Sibugay and the Municipality of Ipil. On 13 February 2008, the Regional Trial Court, Branch 24, rendered a Decision which effectively declared the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Ordinance No. 2001-69, granting franchise to Ipil Square Garden to operate a cockpit in Ipil as null and void and contrary to law. On 08 January 2009, a Writ of Execution was issued by the court. No appeal was taken by the respondents against the 13 February 2008 Decision of the court.

-2- After the Decision of the court and a Writ of Execution was issued, for the year 2009, the Municipality of Ipil did not issue any business permit and license to Ipil Square Garden by reason of the declaration of the court that the aforesaid Sangguniang Panlalawigan Ordinance is null and void and contrary to law. However, according to you, up to present, the Ipil Square Garden has continued to conduct cockfighting activities. Per representation of the counsel of Ipil Square Garden, the said 13 February 2008 Decision of the Regional Trial Court has not attained finality as far as the Ipil Square Garden is concerned and they have filed their appeal. Hence, you are now asking this Department's legal opinion on what action should your municipality undertake under the circumstances given. In this regard, please be advised that we are constrained to refrain from taking any action on the matter in view of the basic constitutional principle of separation of branch and power. As you represented, the instant controversy is already the subject of a Special Civil Case No. 1-71 and is now pending before Branch 24 of the Regional Trial Court of Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay. Thus, the controversy is already within the domain of the judicial branch of the government. Such being the case, this Department is not at good liberty to act on the matter as we might be accused of violating the sub-judice rule, which is considered as a contumacious act against the court. We hope that we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: A . JESU . DOQ Dire tor Ill Director Paisal Abutazi' cc: DILG Regional Office No. IX Pagadian City
